transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling extremely anxious and paranoid lately, like people are constantly watching and monitoring me. On top of that, I've had this massive surge in energy and barely need any sleep, which is making everything feel incredibly intense.

Can you tell me more about these feelings of anxiety and paranoia - have you experienced any periods of depressed mood, or have you primarily been feeling euphoric or irritable with these surges of energy?

I haven't been feeling depressed at all; in fact, my mood has been incredibly high and euphoric, though I get irritated very easily over minor things. I've just had this constant, intense surge of energy that makes me feel like I can keep going forever without stopping. It has been like this for several months now.
Have the feelings of paranoia and being watched been present throughout the entire period of high energy and euphoria, or did they start at some point after these other symptoms began?

The high energy and elevated mood actually started first, about seven months ago. The feelings of being watched and monitored only began much more recently, around two months ago. There have also been times over these past few weeks where I felt that paranoia even when my energy levels weren't as high.

Have you experienced any distinct periods of at least two weeks where you had a depressed mood, even if it was not as prominent as your current euphoric state, at any point in your life or during the time before these recent symptoms started?

No, I have never experienced any periods of feeling depressed or down like that, not even for a couple of weeks. My mood has pretty much always been either normal or really high and energetic. I've never really known what it's like to feel depressed.
For how long have you been experiencing these delusions of being watched, and have they persisted even when your mood was normal or when you weren't experiencing the high energy levels?

Yes, I have been experiencing the feeling of being watched for about two months now. It has definitely persisted for stretches of at least two weeks, even during times when my mood felt completely normal and my energy levels weren't high at all.
Are your delusions of being watched the only psychotic symptoms you've experienced, or have you had any other types of delusions, hallucinations, or disorganized thinking or behavior?

No, it's not just the feeling of being watched. I've also been hearing whispering voices when there is no one around, which has been really unsettling. Sometimes I even get this strong feeling that completely random things, like billboard advertisements or TV shows, are sending specific messages meant just for me.

Can you estimate how much of the time, over the past seven months, you've experienced psychotic symptoms like the voices or delusions of being watched, in relation to your periods of high energy and euphoric mood?

The high energy and elevated mood have definitely been there for most of the last seven months. The voices and the feeling of being watched only started about two months ago, so they overlapped with my high energy during that recent period. Overall, the psychotic symptoms have only been present for a smaller portion of the total time.

Would you say that the psychotic symptoms, such as the voices and delusions, have been prominent and present for a substantial portion of the total duration of your illness, or have they been relatively brief in comparison to your overall mood episode?

While the high energy and elevated mood have been present for the majority of my illness, the voices and delusions have still been very prominent. They occurred concurrently during my high-energy phases, but they also lasted on their own for at least a few weeks when my mood was completely normal.

Can you think of any periods where your mood was neutral or normal, without the high energy or euphoria, and the psychotic symptoms, such as voices or delusions, were still present and prominent, lasting for at least two weeks?

Yes, absolutely. There have definitely been times, lasting at least two weeks, where my mood was completely flat and normal without any of that high energy. Even during those quiet times, the voices and the feeling of being watched were still happening just as intensely.

Did the periods where you experienced psychotic symptoms, such as voices or delusions, without the high energy or euphoric mood, occur for a significant amount of time, such as several months, or were they relatively short-lived?

Those periods without the high energy were relatively short-lived, usually only lasting for about two weeks at a time. Most of the time, the voices and delusions have been happening alongside my high energy and elevated mood. It's really only been for those brief two-week stretches that I experienced them with a normal mood.
